children: Piper Sandler elected Wendy L. Schoppert as a director, effective September 22, 2026, and appointed her to the Audit Committee.
Board election upon recommendation of Nominating and Governance Committee
Board size increased from 10 to 11 directors
Former EVP & CFO of Sleep Number (2011–2014); SVP & CIO (2008–2011); SVP & GM, International and New Channel Development (2005–2008). Director of DaVita and Fossil Group.
